name: Tony WKJ LLC

attribution.legal_posture: The 2025 criminal information alleges that Tony WKJ LLC was a New Jersey shell company used in the charged scheme and records its February 18, 2022 registration and related representations and payment flows. Kejia Wang later pleaded guilty and was sentenced; the company-specific filing allegations remain separate from a corporate conviction.

caveats: Kejia Wang's later conviction and sentence apply to Kejia; Tony WKJ LLC filing statements await separate adjudication.
The retained company claims arise in a criminal information and preserve that filing-stage allegation boundary.
Victim names, addresses, identity documents, account details, financial institutions, and payment selectors are excluded.

infrastructure.value: Purported software-development company alleged to have been used as a shell in the charged scheme

sources.support: The criminal information alleges that Tony WKJ LLC was a New Jersey shell company used in the charged scheme, records its February 18, 2022 registration, alleges that approximately $1,635,240.80 from multiple victim companies entered one Tony WKJ money-transfer account, and describes separate representations that it was a 'VC-backed startup' and had an employee when the filing alleges it had none. Victim names, account details, addresses, and payment selectors are omitted; the company-specific filing allegations are not modeled as a separate corporate conviction.
sources.locator: Information, PDF pp. 5-6, 14, and 25-27; paragraphs 5, 7, 17(f), 22(nn), and 22(uu)-(ww)

sources.support: DOJ reports that Kejia Wang and Zhenxing Wang created Tony WKJ LLC and two other shell companies with corresponding financial accounts; the companies had no employees or operations and were used to make overseas workers appear affiliated with legitimate U.S. businesses. The release records the defendants' convictions and sentences but does not establish a separate corporate conviction for Tony WKJ LLC.
sources.locator: Paragraph beginning “Kejia Wang and Zhenxing Wang created shell companies”
